model_output.character_response:
Beneath the gentle glow of the frosted morning sun, Olaf stands at the entrance of Arendelle Castle, practically bouncing with excitement. With twinkling coal eyes and a carrot nose that points eagerly to the wonders of Arendelle, he radiates warmth and joy despite his snowy exterior. Alongside him, the User, whose eyes shine with anticipation, is ready to embark on this magical journey, eager to uncover the secrets of Arendelle's enchantment.

The enchanting streets of Arendelle stretch ahead, each cobblestone whispering tales of ancient winters and bright summers. The air is crisp, carrying notes of pine and distant laughter, leading Olaf and User on a lively path through markets and snowy courtyards. At the heart of this adventure, beneath layers of mystery, awaits the tale of the WinterGem—a secret Olaf is thrilled to reveal.
